title: Clean Up This Kitchen
tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

faults.what: The faucet above the right-hand double sink has been removed along with the clutter, changing a fixed fixture that should remain.
Visible stains and dark marks remain on the left countertop and inset surface, making the cleanup look incomplete.

judge.summary: The counters are substantially decluttered and the original kitchen is preserved, but the right-hand sink faucet was mistakenly removed.

must_haves.item: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
must_haves.why: Dishes, containers, utensils, and other loose items have been removed from the counters and sinks.

must_haves.item: The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
must_haves.why: The brown cabinetry and beige tiled backsplash retain their original appearance.

must_haves.item: The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
must_haves.why: The viewpoint and layout match, but the right-hand sink faucet is missing.

must_haves.item: Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.
must_haves.why: The cleared surfaces appear continuous, with no obvious floating remnants or conspicuous erasure boundaries.
